batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2023-2024, Set-O — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015-2025), book PDF pp.14-17 (questions; printed answer table on p.17; printed worked solutions pp.18-21). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. Anomalies preserved from the print: Q19 is keyed with two correct options (a, c) in both the answer table and the worked solution, so it is multiple_choice; Q18 options (b) and (d) are printed identically; Q24 depends on a printed circuit diagram (not reproduced in text); Q33's printed worked solution explicitly flags the question as defective (ত্রুটিপূর্ণ) while the table keys it (a) — the key is preserved as tabled. NOTE on Q25: the answer table keys (c) and the printed worked solution (book PDF p.18) also derives and keys (c) ('সমাধান: (c); [P] = [W]/[t] = [ML²T⁻²]/[T] = [ML²T⁻³]'); no 'সঠিক উত্তর নেই' (no-correct-answer) statement appears anywhere in this set's printed solutions (pp.18-21), so NO answerDisposition was applied to Q25 — an upstream section-map note claiming such a statement for this set's Q25 could not be confirmed against the printed pages and was not followed. IMPORT COPY: verified subset (48/80) - see VERIFICATION report.

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015–2025)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-O of JU A Unit 2023-2024 occupies book PDF pp.14-17 (printed book pp.13-16): questions pp.14-17, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') at the foot of p.17, printed worked solutions pp.18-21. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page (zoomed re-reads for spelling-variant options, the answer table and all formula items); mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π). NOTE: the SHA-256 recorded here is the hash computed from the archived file itself; it differs from the value quoted in the extraction brief (5aad47e0…), which does not match the archived file.
